Description
Buy gold online with Bullion Trading LLC and add a valuable asset to your investment portfolio. The 1 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Rosa Bar is a highly sought-after bullion product produced by PAMP (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux), the world’s leading bullion brand. With its exceptional quality and craftsmanship, PAMP Suisse ensures that each bar is a reliable and valuable investment.
The 1 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Rosa Bar contains 1 gram (0.0321 troy oz) of .9999 pure gold. Its exquisite Rosa design adds elegance and beauty to this small yet significant piece. PAMP Suisse incorporates advanced technology, such as
Veriscan®
, allowing for easy verification of authenticity and origin.
Design of the 1 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Rosa Bar
The obverse side of this gold bar showcases a captivating Rosa design, symbolizing beauty and sophistication. On the reverse side, you’ll find the PAMP Suisse logo, along with essential details including the weight, purity, and a unique serial number. Each bar also comes with an assay card to provide further assurance.

Contains 1 gram (0.0321 troy oz) of .9999 pure gold.
